item.title: Healthy lifestyle may cut infection risk in type 2 diabetes patients
item.description: Adherence to a healthy lifestyle is linked to an approximately 44% lower incidence of infections among type 2 diabetes patients.

item.title: Looksmaxxing trend raises body dysmorphia concerns in teen boys
item.description: The maxxing trend varies clinically: sleepmaxxing uses established sleep hygiene, while looksmaxxing may escalate into body dysmorphia.

item.title: Real-world use confirms safety of sofpironium gel
item.description: Post-marketing surveillance shows adverse events consistent with the known safety profile of sofpironium gel for excessive underarm sweating.

item.title: AI tool helps novices capture heart ultrasound and spot aortic stenosis
item.description: Mayo Clinic researchers tested an AI-guided approach enabling people without ultrasound experience to capture heart images and identify aortic stenosis.
